MinDepthForBatComment: min vertical blocks below sea level to allow bats
BatChanceComment: chance (0-1) to roll for bat spawn each interval
FlockDistanceComment: distance at which to switch to flock sound
ScaredDistanceComment: distance at which to switch to scared sound
FadeOutDistanceComment: max distance at which bat sounds still play
FadeSecondsComment: duration of fade transitions between layers
